title: Ambient tensor coordinates before the second conormal pullback
statement: Let i:Z→X and i':Z'→X' be closed immersions [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf] in a cartesian square [def-pc-fibre-product] with maps g:X→X' and f:Z→Z' and equality h:i≫g=f≫i'. Fix affine opens U⊆X and U'⊆X' with U⊆g⁻¹U'. Put A=Γ(X',U'), B=Γ(X,U), J=i'.ker.ideal U', V'=i'⁻¹U', V=i⁻¹U, C=Γ(Z',V'), D=Γ(Z,V), and N=Γ((tensorPullback i').obj i'.ker.toModules,V') [def-pc-module-pullback]. The algebra structures are induced by g.appLE and f.appLE; the inclusion V⊆f⁻¹V' follows from h. There exists an additive equivalence e:B⊗_A J.Cotangent ≃ N⊗_C D. For b∈B, a∈J and an ideal section s' over U' with i'.ker.toModulesι(s')=a, it sends b⊗class(a) to η_i'(s')⊗i.app(U)(b), where η_i' is the chosen normalized tensor-pullback adjunction unit. This equivalence concerns only tensor modules, not sections of the second pullback f* N.

proof.text: Put A=Gamma(X',U'), B=Gamma(X,U), J=i'.ker.ideal U'. The inverse-image opens V' and V are affine and the immersion section maps are surjective, by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-affine-cover-criterion]. The given cartesian cone is isomorphic to the chosen pullback. Kernel invariance under that isomorphism and Mathlib IdealSheafData.ker_fst_of_isClosedImmersion identify i.ker with i'.ker.comap g. Apply [lem-pc-ideal-sheaf-comap-affine-extension] to get i.ker.ideal U=JB. The first isomorphism theorem identifies the section rings C=Gamma(Z',V') and D=Gamma(Z,V) with A/J and B/JB; commutativity supplies the compatible induced ring map C to D.

Apply affine_conormal_sections to i', U', R=A and r=id. The ideal J is ker(i'.app U'), so it gives an A-linear equivalence J.Cotangent≃N, normalized on ideal representatives. Both modules carry the quotient C=A/J action: the action on N restricts along i'.app and J annihilates J.Cotangent. Surjectivity of A→C upgrades the equivalence to C-linearity. The square equality makes C→D compatible with A→B→D.

Cancel the quotient scalar ring C=A/J to identify N⊗_C D with N⊗_A D, using annihilation of J on N. Transport the conormal equivalence and swap factors to identify this with D⊗_A J.Cotangent. Since D=B/JB, base-change tensor cancellation and the quotient tensor equivalence identify the latter with (B⊗_A J.Cotangent)/(JB•⊤). The denominator is zero: for a∈J, g(a)•(b⊗m)=b⊗(a•m)=0; tensor induction extends this to all tensors, and ideal-map generation extends it to JB. Remove the zero quotient and invert the composite to get e.

Trace the canonical pure-tensor formulas of scalar cancellation, quotient tensor equivalence and tensor swap. They send b⊗class(a) to class(a)⊗i.app(b). The normalized conormal equivalence sends class(a) to the i' adjunction unit on s', giving exactly the required equation. No unit for f or second sheaf pullback is used here. For J=0 the two tensor modules vanish; for J=A the source chart ring C and conormal vanish. Zero rings give the same zero-module calculation, and no flatness was used.

theorem closedImmersion_conormal_affine_tensor_coordinates
    {X Z X' Z' : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) (i' : Z' ⟶ X')
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [IsClosedImmersion i']
    (g : X ⟶ X') (f : Z ⟶ Z') (h : i ≫ g = f ≫ i')
    (hc : IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk i f h))
    (U : X.affineOpens) (U' : X'.affineOpens) (H : U.1 ≤ g ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1) :
    letI : Algebra Γ(X', U'.1) Γ(X, U.1) := (g.appLE U'.1 U.1 H).hom.toAlgebra
    let V' : Z'.affineOpens := ⟨i' ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1, U'.2.preimage i'⟩
    let V : Z.affineOpens := ⟨i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1, U.2.preimage i⟩
    let K : V.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ V'.1 := by
      change i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1 ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ i' ⁻¹ᵁ U'.1
      rw [← Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage, ← h, Scheme.Hom.comp_preimage]
      exact i.preimage_mono H
    letI : Algebra Γ(Z', V'.1) Γ(Z, V.1) := (f.appLE V'.1 V.1 K).hom.toAlgebra
    ∃ e : (Γ(X, U.1) ⊗[Γ(X', U'.1)] (i'.ker.ideal U').Cotangent) ≃+
        (Γ((tensorPullback i').obj i'.ker.toModules, V'.1) ⊗[Γ(Z', V'.1)] Γ(Z, V.1)),
      ∀ (b : Γ(X, U.1)) (a : i'.ker.ideal U') (s' : Γ(i'.ker.toModules, U'.1)),
        i'.ker.toModulesι.app U'.1 s' = (a : Γ(X', U'.1)) →
        e (b ⊗ₜ[Γ(X', U'.1)] (i'.ker.ideal U').toCotangent a) =
          (show Γ((tensorPullback i').obj i'.ker.toModules, V'.1) from
            ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction i')).unit.app
              i'.ker.toModules).app U'.1 s') ⊗ₜ[Γ(Z', V'.1)] i.app U.1 b
